The Mary-creature is noted for having a slangy manner of speech. She is described as using unrefined language.

## History

The Mary-creature was found literally starving by the [Merediths](../codex/factions.md#merediths) in [James](../character/james-a.md) Taylor's old hay barn. Prior to this, she had been ill-used and mercilessly whipped for every small fault by Mrs. [Wiley](../character/wiley.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P4](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008)_
